Under Northbridge policy, **lithium-cell parts** (which includes `BAT-500`) may only be purchased from suppliers holding a **valid UN 38.3 certificate** on file in Ledgerline:
> *"Lithium-cell parts (battery packs, hub motors, chargers and any other item marked lithium-cell in the item master) may be bought only from a supplier holding a valid UN 38.3 certificate on file in Ledgerline... An expired certificate counts as no certificate."* (POL-PUR-001 §6.2)

* **Nordic Cell Co. (`NC-GDA-0063`)**: UN 38.3 certificate (`UN38.3-TR/NC/2025/090`) **expired on 30 September 2026** (26 days ago).
